answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 145749 Country: India Title: Every year I give foods to the underprivileged on Muharram for my elders who are not alive with niyat. Is this a bida’h? Question: Every year I give foods to the underprivileged on Muharram for my elders who are not alive with niyat. Is this a bida’h? Answer ID: 145749 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 80/43/SN=2/1438) No doubt it is a rewarding deed to feed the poor and indigent people but the specification of the month of Muharram has no basis, there is no special virtue of doing isal-e-sawab in the month of Muharram as per the Shariah. You may feed in any other month as per your capacity, it is bida’h to fix the month of Muharram for it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
